An '''ignition key''' was a type of key used to start [[Farm/Legends|farm]] equipment. The [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] used ignition keys to start their plowing equipment.

During the invasion of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Wass]] used one to start a machine and plow over droids.
